name: Nyírkércs (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyírkercs (a quartered yellow, green and red shield with ears of grain, a tree and a sabre) below the name NYÍRKERCS in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
